descricao: Photo of a tea field with a mountain in the distance taken 18/08/23 The Charwood Hills has an unusual diurnal cycle, consisting of twenty-one hours of daylight with only three hours of darkness. While exploring at night, wanderers should always bring a light source with them if no source of light can be found, then it is recommended by the locals of the Charwood Hills to tread with caution or stick to familiar areas, as the topography of the level is very gnarled with hidden rocky ditches and deep ponds.
